# v2.2.0

## Multi-Roblox on macOS, now with modern Cocoa

This release fixes a startup crash on modern macOS and brings the build,
distribution, and developer experience up to modern standards.

## What's new

- **Multi-instance** — run multiple Roblox players in parallel, one
  per browser account. Teleport between places still works.
- **Apple Silicon and Intel** — native arm64 and amd64 builds, plus a
  universal binary.
- **Modern Cocoa UI** — the entire UI is now a tiny native AppKit window
  (~110 lines of Objective-C). No more darwinkit.
- **Code-signed and notarized DMG** — releases can be signed with a
  Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so they install without
  Gatekeeper warnings. (Signing is opt-in and runs only when the
  appropriate secrets are provided to the release workflow.)

## What's changed

- `darwinkit` (the old Cocoa wrapper) has been removed. The app now
  uses a ~110-line Objective-C bridge for the window and event loop.
- The Info.plist now registers the `roblox-player://` URL scheme via
  `CFBundleURLTypes`. macOS routes every Roblox deeplink to this app.
- `os.WriteFile` and `plist.Decode` errors are now propagated instead
  of silently dropped.
- `Close All` sends SIGTERM before SIGKILL, so Roblox can flush state.
- Dead code (`pkg/fspath/homedir`, `pkg/fspath/libdir`,
  `pkg/fspath/shortenpath`) has been removed.

## Verified by the maintainer

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| macOS | 26 Tahoe |
| Architecture | Apple Silicon (arm64) |
| Go | 1.23, 1.26 |

Two Roblox instances running simultaneously, one per browser account:

![Two Roblox instances](docs/images/two-instances.png)

## Known issues

- The CoreFoundation log line `CFURLCopyResourcePropertyForKey failed
  because it was passed a URL which has no scheme` is printed once at
  startup. This is a benign warning from AppKit, not an error.
- Already-open Roblox windows are not refreshed when Roblox updates
  itself. Quit the player and start a new instance to pick up the new
  version.
- Compatibility with macOS versions other than 26 Tahoe, and with
  Intel hardware, has not been verified by the maintainer. Community
  testing is welcome.

## How to install

1. Download `multi-roblox-macos-2.2.0.dmg` below.
2. Open the DMG and drag `multiroblox.app` to the Applications folder.
3. Launch the app from Applications.
4. Open [roblox.com](https://www.roblox.com) in your browser, sign in
   to the account you want to play, and click Play.
5. Switch to a different account and click Play again to spawn a
   second, independent instance.

## Verifying the download

Each release artifact is generated by the GitHub Actions release
workflow. To verify a binary, compare its SHA-256 against the value
printed in the workflow run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 multi-roblox-macos-2.2.0.dmg
```
